description: Personal data categories used to classify discovered data elements. Definitions are written for this project. Synonyms are field name variants seen in forms, API payloads and database columns.

categories.label: Name
categories.definition: A natural person's given name, family name or full name.

categories.label: E-mail address
categories.definition: An electronic mail address of a person.

categories.label: Telephone number
categories.definition: A fixed or mobile telephone number of a person.

categories.label: Postal address
categories.definition: Street address, city, postcode or country of residence or delivery.

categories.label: Date of birth
categories.definition: A person's birth date or exact age.

categories.label: Gender or title
categories.definition: Gender, salutation or title of a person.

categories.label: National or insurance identifier
categories.definition: A government issued identifier such as a national identity, tax, social security or health insurance number.

categories.label: Bank account
categories.definition: An account number or IBAN used for payments to or from a person.

categories.label: Payment card
categories.definition: A payment card number, expiry date or security code.

categories.label: IP address
categories.definition: An internet protocol address of a device used by a person.

categories.label: Online identifier
categories.definition: A cookie value, visitor id, user id, advertising id or similar pseudonymous identifier that singles out a person or device.

categories.label: Device and browser data
categories.definition: Device model, operating system, browser, screen size, language and other technical details that can fingerprint a device.

categories.label: Location
categories.definition: Precise or approximate location of a person or device.

categories.label: Employment and professional data
categories.definition: Job title, employer, department, manager, working hours, salary or other data about a person's work.

categories.label: Communications content
categories.definition: The content of messages, tickets, chat transcripts, notes and free text written by or about a person.

categories.label: Purchase and transaction history
categories.definition: Orders, items bought, totals, invoices and payment status linked to a person.

categories.label: Browsing and usage behavior
categories.definition: Pages viewed, clicks, search terms, referrers, session duration and other usage events.

categories.label: Authentication credentials
categories.definition: Passwords, password hashes, tokens, security questions and other secrets that prove identity.

categories.label: Photograph or image
categories.definition: A photograph, scan or video of a person, including identity document images.

categories.label: Family and emergency contacts
categories.definition: Details about relatives, dependants or emergency contacts of a person.

categories.label: Insurance data
categories.definition: Insurer, policy number and cover details of a person.

categories.label: Nationality and right to work
categories.definition: Citizenship, nationality, residence permit or work authorization status.

categories.label: Consent record
categories.definition: Evidence that a person agreed to something, such as a timestamp, wording version or opt-in flag.

categories.label: Preferences and interests
categories.definition: Declared interests, topics, communication preferences and settings.

categories.label: Criminal record data
categories.definition: Criminal convictions, offences or the result of a background check. Regulated by Article 10 rather than Article 9.

categories.label: Health data
categories.definition: Information about physical or mental health, including symptoms, diagnoses, treatment, appointments for care and disability.

categories.label: Trade union membership
categories.definition: Whether a person belongs to a trade union or similar body.

categories.label: Racial or ethnic origin
categories.definition: Race, ethnicity or ethnic background of a person.

categories.label: Biometric data
categories.definition: Fingerprints, face templates, voiceprints or other data used to identify a person uniquely.

categories.label: Genetic data
categories.definition: Information about inherited or acquired genetic characteristics of a person.

categories.label: Political opinions
categories.definition: Political views or party affiliation of a person.

categories.label: Religious or philosophical beliefs
categories.definition: Religion or philosophical conviction of a person.

categories.label: Sex life or sexual orientation
categories.definition: Information about a person's sex life or sexual orientation.
